title: Project Manager and Designer
description: Project Manager asks Designer to turn the reference image into a Minecraft blueprint. Designer reports assumptions, tool calls, artifacts, and uncertain visual regions.

messages.text: Designer, inspect workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png and produce placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, and uncertainty notes. Keep assumptions explicit for later Foreman planning.
messages.systemLog: pm INFO request designer-blueprint input=workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png out=runs/tiantan_build_001/blueprint

messages.text: Front face is usable; back side is not visible. I marked the roof lip, entrance lanterns, and right-side trim as low-confidence zones before reconstruction.
messages.systemLog: designer DEBUG cues saved to vision/cues.json: footprint=oval-ish symmetry_axis=x0 tiers=3 occluded_faces=back,angled-rear

messages.text: Calling TRELLIS from the run folder: reconstruct mesh from the single image with seed 2147 and write mesh.obj plus camera.json.
Calling obj2schematic to voxelize mesh.obj into a Minecraft grid with the project palette and 0.42 block tolerance.
Exporting the schematic into sorted block placements, layer numbers, and region bounds so Project Manager can split work without reading the binary schem file.
Blueprint ready. I am returning placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, mesh_review.json, cues.json, and 23 low-confidence placements in uncertain_edges.json.
